Teks: *"Rian wants to invite his friend Bayu over to study together."* Jadi yang diundang adalah Bayu.

Kunci Jawaban: **B (Bayu)**

content: Hey, does this belong to you? … bag is very nice.
explanation:
Sebelum kata benda *bag* dibutuhkan kata kepemilikan *your* (*your bag*). *You're* = *you are*, *yours* berdiri sendiri tanpa kata benda.

Kunci Jawaban: **A (Your)**

content: Which of these vehicles is the slowest?
explanation:
Urutan dari yang paling cepat: pesawat → helikopter → kereta → mobil → sepeda. Yang paling lambat adalah sepeda (*bicycle*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Bicycle)**

content: Bicycle is slower than ….
explanation:
Sepeda lebih lambat daripada sepeda motor (*motorcycle*). Becak dan delman tidak lebih cepat dari sepeda.

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Motorcycle)**

content: This is water transportation, except ….
explanation:
Kapal, perahu, dan kapal selam adalah transportasi air. Kereta (*train*) adalah transportasi darat.

Kunci Jawaban: **D (Train)**

content: The passengers get on the plane at the …..
explanation:
Penumpang naik pesawat di bandara (*airport*).

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Airport)**

content: Bicycle and pedicab are … transportation.
explanation:
Sepeda dan becak berjalan di darat, jadi termasuk transportasi darat (*land transportation*).

content: For his birthday, he wants the … gift.
explanation:
Bentuk paling (*superlative*) dari kata sifat panjang seperti *expensive* adalah *the most expensive*.

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Most expensive)**

content: Look at the picture! The book is … and the juice is ….
explanation:
Pada gambar, harga buku Rp75.000 (mahal/*expensive*) dan jus Rp5.000 (murah/*cheap*).

Kunci Jawaban: **A (Expensive, cheap)**

Sepeda yang mengilap dan baru dibelikan kemarin adalah sepeda baru (*new*).

content:
Bagas ran fast during the race yesterday.
“Fast” in this sentence is a ….
explanation:
*Fast* menjelaskan bagaimana Bagas berlari (cara), jadi termasuk *adverb of manner*.

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Adverb of manner)**

content:
“I don't understand why he behaved like that.”
The word *why* in this sentence is a/an ….
explanation:
*Why* di sini memulai pertanyaan tidak langsung (*why he behaved like that*), jadi berfungsi sebagai *interrogative adverb*. *Relative adverb* biasanya mengikuti kata benda, misalnya *the reason why*.

Kunci Jawaban: **D (Interrogative adverb)**

content:
“Ratna is going to arrive on time tomorrow.”
The phrase *on time* in this sentence is a/an ….
explanation:
*On time* adalah kelompok kata (frasa) yang berfungsi sebagai keterangan, jadi disebut *adverbial phrase*.

Kunci Jawaban: **A (Adverbial phrase)**

content:
“He always cleans his room on Sundays.”
The word *always* in this sentence is a/an ….
explanation:
*Always* menyatakan seberapa sering sesuatu dilakukan, jadi termasuk *adverb of frequency*.

Kunci Jawaban: **D (Adverb of frequency)**

content:
“She missed her class in the afternoon yesterday, I don't know why.”
The word *yesterday* in this sentence is a/an ….
explanation:
*Yesterday* menyatakan kapan peristiwa terjadi, jadi termasuk *adverb of time*.

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Adverb of time)**

:::passage[Teks Cerita (Soal No. 33 – 36)]
*The following text is for question number 33 to 36:*

Hi! My name is Vino Curious. I live on the second floor of an apartment in a busy city. I'm a very curious boy and I always want to know what my neighbors are doing. Right now, I'm watching the park across the street through my binoculars.
Let me look at the playground on Melur Street. It's full of children as always. Sarah is jumping rope and Tia is playing with her ball. Iqbal and Reza are walking their dogs, they love animals so much. Kevin is playing on the slide while his sister is on the swing.
Made, Dodi, and Ayu are chasing each other and laughing. Nisa is playing badminton with a group of kids, but she isn't very good at it. Mr. and Mrs. Hartono are sitting on a bench, chatting and enjoying the sun. A few teenagers are sitting under a big tree, talking. Aji is running while flying his kite, and his friend Toni is clapping happily.
It's so nice to watch people from my window, but I must go now.
:::

“… now I'm watching the park across the street through my binoculars.”
Which tool is Vino using to watch the park?
explanation:
Vino berkata *"I'm watching the park across the street through my binoculars."* Binoculars adalah teropong berlensa dua.

Kunci Jawaban: **C (Binoculars)**

:::passage[Teks Cerita (Soal No. 37 – 40)]
*The following text is for question number 37 to 40:*

Mom just came home from Batu to Surabaya. She brought us 6 kilograms of oranges. When I counted them, there were 48 oranges in total. Mom made four packs of oranges, each pack has 6 oranges. One for the neighbor, one for aunt Ratih, one for grandpa, and one for our teacher. I saw my sister had already eaten two oranges, while I hadn't taken any yet. Mom saved a dozen and kept them in the fridge. She said she would make orange juice tomorrow. She asked me to put the rest on a plate.
:::

Where did Mom buy the oranges?
explanation:
Teks: *"Mom just came home from Batu to Surabaya."* Jeruk dibeli di Batu.

Kunci Jawaban: **A (Batu)**
